assets.name: tl_env_cave_floor_v01
assets.notes: Cave floor disc r=21 m, cave space (origin = campfire, place at 0,0,0). Walkable centre r<14 is nearly flat (0<=y<0.035); rises to ~0.5 m under the walls (buries the wall bases), stays flat at the tunnel mouth (-Z). Large dark-earth facets.

meta.heightNote: y in [0, 0.035] for r < 14; rises toward the walls (~0.25 m at r = 19, ~0.5 m at r = 21)

walkBoundary.note: [thetaDeg, r] closest wall/ledge geometry below 1.8 m per 5 deg bin (theta from +X toward -Z). Keep players inside r - 0.4. Bins around theta = 90 (the exit) see the tunnel walls, not the mouth.

meta.angleConvention: theta around +Y from +X toward -Z; dir = (cos t, 0, -sin t)

assets.name: tl_env_cave_ceiling_v01
assets.notes: Irregular cave ceiling, cave space (place at 0,0,0): ~14 m at the centre, meets the leaning walls at ~12 m, rim r=20.5 m at ~11 m hidden behind the walls. Faces point down (single-sided). Includes 8 massive hanging rock cones (2.4-4.4 m) and 20 merged stalactites (1.5-4.2 m).

meta.heightNote: ceiling y ~= 14 - 3 * (r / 20.5)^2.5 (+-0.5 m noise inside r = 14)

assets.name: tl_env_stalactite_a_v01
assets.notes: Single hanging stalactite, 3.0 m. Modelled hanging: tip at y=0, ceiling attachment at the top (anchor 'attach'). Place at (x, ceilingY - 2.9, z).

assets.name: tl_env_stalactite_b_v01
assets.notes: Cluster of 3 hanging stalactites (2.2 / 1.4 / 0.9 m). Tip at y=0, attachment at the top (anchor 'attach').

assets.name: tl_env_stalagmite_a_v01
assets.notes: Tiered stalagmite 1.7 m (style reference: stepped spikes near the water).

assets.name: tl_env_stalagmite_b_v01
assets.notes: Stalagmite pair 2.4 m + 1.1 m with a rubble base.

assets.name: tl_env_rock_cluster_a_v01
assets.notes: Boulder group: 2.4 m boulder + four smaller rocks, ~4 x 3 m footprint.

assets.name: tl_env_rock_cluster_b_v01
assets.notes: Three-boulder cluster 1.0-1.55 m (prop catalogue 'ROCK CLUSTER').

assets.name: tl_env_rock_cluster_c_v01
assets.notes: Low flat-topped slab rocks ~1 m (shelf for a torch / seat) with rubble.

assets.name: tl_env_stone_small_a_v01
assets.notes: Flat floor stone 0.4 m (concept 01 foreground slabs). Cosmetic, no collider.

assets.name: tl_env_stone_small_b_v01
assets.notes: Chunky pebble 0.24 m. Cosmetic, no collider.

assets.name: tl_env_stone_small_c_v01
assets.notes: Tiny pebble 0.12 m. Cosmetic, no collider.

assets.name: tl_env_stone_small_d_v01
assets.notes: Three small pebbles (0.1-0.2 m) as one scatter piece. Cosmetic, no collider.

assets.name: tl_env_puddle_v01
assets.notes: Shallow irregular puddle ~6 x 4 m. Water surface is its own node 'water' (y=0.05, separate mesh) so the runtime can give it a glossy material (keep diffuseVertexColor). Root: wet mud rim + wet rim stones. Place where the floor is flat (cave r < 14).

meta.note: Swap the 'water' entity's material for a glossy one (e.g. gloss 0.85, metalness 0, keep diffuseVertexColor).

assets.name: tl_env_tunnel_frame_v01
assets.notes: Rough wooden mine frame for the exit tunnel: two posts + lintel + knee braces, sized to the 3.5 x 3.6 m mouth (clear opening 2.84 x 2.78 m). Faces +Z (into the cave). Place at cave (0, 0, -18.35) rotY 0 (wall module 01 anchor 'tunnel_frame'). The entrance sign mounts at anchor 'sign'.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_floor_v01
assets.notes: Shrine grotto floor, r = 15.6 m, shrine space (origin = idol, +Z = the way in). Packed earth, exactly flat (y = 0) inside r = 9.3, rising under the rock walls; rough flagstones (1.4 cm proud) around the plinth, on the approach from +Z and as stepping stones between the seats on the r = 3 and r = 5 circles; trodden paler bands on those circles; darker toward the rim.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_seat_a_v01
assets.notes: Rough stone block seat with a faded crimson cloth strip over it (inner ring). Flat top at exactly y = 0.48, no backrest. The seated avatar's root stands at anchor 'sit' (0.16 m in front of the block centre) facing +Z, so its calves clear the block's front face. Carries its own dark contact patch.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_seat_b_v01
assets.notes: Rough stone block seat, plain (outer ring). Flat top at exactly y = 0.48, no backrest. The seated avatar's root stands at anchor 'sit' (0.16 m in front of the block centre) facing +Z, so its calves clear the block's front face. Carries its own dark contact patch.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_idol_v01
assets.notes: Shrine idol, 3.3 m with its rock plinth (fits the r = 1.2 obstacle): a fan-carved, painted wooden caricature of the champion the cave prays to - heavy straight fringe / bowl hair, thin round wire glasses, slim oval face, calm; white jersey with black raglan shoulders and side panels and red collar piping (worn paint, no logos or text), in the 'silent' pose: right index finger raised to the lips, left arm at the side. The trophy floats above the head as its own model (tl_env_shrine_trophy_v01, anchor 'trophy'). A real crimson cloth cloak (tl_cloth) hangs from the shoulders. Offerings on the plinth and its front ledge: candles (glow), a noodle cup, mugs, flowers, notes.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_trophy_v01
assets.notes: The championship trophy that floats above the shrine idol: a generic low-poly cup, 0.96 m tall - stepped base, slim stem with a knot, a wide flaring bowl and two tall looping handles (no logos, plates or text). Every face is emissive (tl_glow, pale silver-blue with warm gold bands), shaded per facet so the form reads without light. The runtime spins it about Y, bobs it and puts a pulsing omni at 'light_anchor'. Pivot: centre of the base.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_gate_v01
assets.notes: Rough timber gate (two leaning posts, a long top beam, a tie beam) with a paper-strip rope and rags knotted to the posts; clear opening 2.8 m wide, 2.7 m under the rope. Faces +Z. It marks the shrine's way back to the cave, in front of the tunnel mouth on the +Z side. Lanterns hang at anchors 'lantern_l' / 'lantern_r'.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_banner_v01
assets.notes: Banner pole 4.3 m: a leaning timber pole with a cross arm and a long tattered crimson cloth (worn-white patches, no emblem), base rocks. The cloth faces +Z. The rim rope ties on at anchor 'tie' (1.12 m).

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_post_v01
assets.notes: Rope post of the shrine rim, 1.45 m: a rough timber post wedged between two rocks, rope lashing and rags at 1.12 m (anchor 'tie'). Two of them leave the opening of the rope circle on the approach.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_rope_v01
assets.notes: Rim rope of the shrine: 4.61 m span between two posts (ends at y = 1.12 m, anchors 'end_l' / 'end_r'), sagging 0.3 m, with paper strips and faded rags: a low cordon that marks the edge of the walkable circle and stays under a follow camera's view. Cosmetic, no collider.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_candles_v01
assets.notes: A flat stone with five wax candles (unlit glow flames) and a note. Light anchor 'light'. Cosmetic.

assets.name: tl_env_shrine_door_v01
assets.notes: Cave-side door of the shrine. Place at the tunnel frame, cave (0, 0, -18.35) rotY 0 (tl_env_tunnel_frame_v01 stays as the porch): a rough plank double door recessed in the tunnel mouth 1 m behind the frame (z = -1.03; the right leaf stands half open inward, a faded cloth is pinned to the closed leaf), a two-plank name board hung by ropes from the frame's lintel (anchor 'sign' = the board's face, 2.5 x 0.8 m), two lantern brackets on the posts (anchors 'lantern_l' / 'lantern_r'). Authored around the frame's pivot, so its bounds are not centred (expected pivot warning).
